question: Who among the following wrote the novel Godaan, which is considered a classic of modern Hindi literature?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Munshi Premchand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Munshi Premchand** is one of the most celebrated authors in modern Hindi and Urdu literature.
 
• His novel **Godaan**, meaning "The Gift of a Cow," is considered a masterpiece and a cornerstone of Hindi literature.
